articles.title: US Natural Gas Futures Dip on Lower Flows to LNG Export Plants
articles.summary: US natural gas futures ended lower as domestic gas flows to liquefied natural gas export terminals along the US Gulf Coast dropped for a third consecutive day. The reduction is concentrated at Sabine Pass LNG in Louisiana and Corpus Christi LNG in Texas.

articles.title: Colombia’s Pro-Trump Presidential Frontrunner Thrills Investors
articles.summary: Exuberant market reaction to a celebrity lawyer’s surprise victory in Colombia’s first-round election Sunday is sowing expectations for an investment rebound in the resource-rich Andean country.
